    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Account
    Represents a Fetion user account, holding identity information such as user ID, mobile number, SIP URI, password, presence state and AES credentials used for credential decryption.
    Activity
    Abstract base class for SIPC activities (dialogues and sub-activities).
    AddBuddyActivity
    SIPC activity for adding a buddy by mobile number or Fetion user ID.
    AuthDigest
    Represents the SIPC authentication digest exchanged during registration (W header in the response, A header in the request).
    AuthFeedback
    Callback interface for authentication feedback, allowing callers to submit a captcha code, cancel the operation, or request a new captcha image.
    AuthFeedbackImpl
    Default implementation of AuthFeedback that coordinates captcha image retrieval and user input via a CountDownLatch.
    AuthGeneratorV4
    Generates the RSA-encrypted authentication response for SIPC V4 login.
    AuthSupportable
    Callback interface invoked when the server requires captcha-based authentication.
    Base64
    Provides Base64 encoding and decoding as defined by RFC 2045.
    Buddy
    Represents a buddy (friend) in the Fetion contact list, extending Personal with a Relation status.
    BuddyGroup
    Named group for organising buddies in the contact list.
    Captcha
    Represents a captcha challenge issued by the server during authentication.
    CaptchaImpl
    Default implementation of the Captcha interface, holding captcha image data, verification algorithm details, and the user-entered code.
    ChatDialogue
    SIPC dialogue for sending instant messages and SMS to a specific buddy.
    ClientHelper
    Utility class providing SIPC message key generation, URI classification helpers, SID extraction, and captcha image retrieval from the server.
    CmccMobileValidator
    Validates whether a given mobile number belongs to the China Mobile (CMCC) network by checking against known number-range definitions loaded from XML.
    Contact
    Aggregates the full contact list: buddy groups, buddies, and a blacklist.
    Controller
    Central controller for SIPC signalling transport and reception.
    ConvertHelper
    Utility class for converting between byte arrays, hex strings, UTF-8 strings, integers, and input streams.
    DeleteBuddyActivity
    SIPC activity for removing a buddy from the contact list, with an option to also remove oneself from the buddy's list (delete-both).
    Dialogue
    Abstract base class for SIPC dialogues that can receive incoming messages.
    DigestHelper
    Cryptographic digest utility providing MD5, SHA-1 hashing and AES-256 key generation for the Fetion authentication protocol.
    Dispatcher
    Dispatches SIPC requests to the server and correlates responses.
    Fetion
    Main entry point for the Fetion SDK.
    FetionConsole
    High-level console interface returned after a successful login.
    FetionConsoleImpl
    Default implementation of FetionConsole that delegates buddy and messaging operations to the underlying Controller.
    FetionContext
    Read-only context providing access to account, system configuration, user info, mobile validator, and the log handler for a Fetion session.
    FetionException
    Base checked exception for all Fetion SDK errors.
    LogHandler
    Pluggable logging interface for SIPC message traffic and SDK diagnostics.
    MainDialogue
    Primary SIPC dialogue responsible for login, logout, keep-alive heartbeat, and dispatching server-push notifications (presence changes, buddy sync).
    NotifyListener
    Listener interface for asynchronous server-side events such as login completion, buddy changes, presence updates and SMS count notifications.
    PasswordEncrypterV4
    Password encryption utility for the Fetion V4 protocol.
    Personal
    Extended user model carrying personal profile data: SID, mobile number, nickname, impresa (signature), carrier info, SMS online status, and current presence state.
    Presence
    Enumeration of Fetion user presence states with their numeric protocol values.
    Provider
    Abstraction for reading cached system configuration and user information.
    ProviderFactory
    Factory interface for creating Provider instances keyed by mobile number.
    Quota
    Holds quota and rate-limit information for a Fetion account, including maximum buddy count and daily/monthly SMS sending limits.
    Relation
    Enumeration of buddy relationship statuses used in the Fetion contact list.
    RequestMessage
    SIPC request message sent from the client to the server.
    ResponseMessage
    SIPC response message received from the server.
    Result
    Immutable value object representing the outcome of a Fetion operation, carrying an HTTP-style status code, status message, success/failure type, and a human-readable description.
    Result.Type
     
    SimpleProvider
    File-system-backed Provider implementation that also acts as a NotifyListener to persist system-config and user-info changes to local XML files.
    SimpleProviderFactory
    Default ProviderFactory that creates SimpleProvider instances.
    Sipc
    Constants for the SIPC 4.0 protocol: field names, method names, and status codes used throughout the Fetion SDK.
    SipcMessage
    Abstract base class for all SIPC messages.
    SipcMessageReader
    Reads and parses SIPC messages from an InputStream, constructing either RequestMessage or ResponseMessage objects depending on the headline format.
    SipcMessageWriter
    Writes SIPC messages to an OutputStream in the standard SIPC wire format.
    StringHelper
    General-purpose string utility: HTML escaping/unescaping, tag stripping, positional formatting, URL encoding, Base64 decoding, and case manipulation.
    SubActivity
    Auxiliary activity that subscribes to PresenceV4 events on the server after a successful login.
    SystemConfig
    Represents the Fetion system configuration retrieved from the server.
    TcpTransfer
    TCP-based Transfer implementation that opens a raw socket to the SIPC server and reads/writes SipcMessage objects via SipcMessageReader and SipcMessageWriter.
    Template
    Constants holding XML template strings for system-config requests, user authentication, buddy addition, and buddy deletion.
    Transfer
    Abstraction for the underlying network transport used to exchange SIPC messages with the server.
    TransferException
    Checked exception thrown when a network transport operation fails.
    TransferProxy
    Proxy Transfer implementation that automatically selects the primary or backup SIPC proxy server from the system configuration.
    User
    Base model class representing a Fetion user, identified by a numeric user ID, a SIP URI, and a display name.
    UserHelper
    Reflection-based helper that converts between XmlElement and user-model objects (User,
    invalid reference 
    Buddy
    , etc.) using getter/setter introspection.
    UserInfo
    Aggregates all user-related data: personal profile, contact list (buddy groups, buddies, blacklist), and SMS quota.
    XmlElement
    XmlElement is a representation of an XML object.
    XmlElementHelper
    Helper methods for navigating XmlElement trees by XPath-like paths, reading/writing XML files, and extracting node content and attributes.
    XmlParseException
    An XmlParseException is thrown when an error occures while parsing an XML string.
